results.name: SemMed treatment-parent with multisource binding and genetic support
results.hypothesis: A SemMed treatment-family assertion becomes highly predictive when a directly inhibited causal target has non-SemMed disease evidence and binding support from at least four resources.
results.body: direct inhibited causal target plus SemMed treatment-parent assertion, non-SemMed gene-disease evidence, >=4 binding sources, and non-hub disease
results.mechanism_rationale: Combines a direct perturbation path, causal disease genetics, independent genetic support, and binding consensus; the treatment-family assertion is literature-derived and disease activity direction remains absent.
results.trapi_notes: The causal-target and treatment-parent motifs are TRAPI-expressible; binding-source cardinality, derived genetic evidence, and disease degree require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
WITH subject, object, gene, evidence,
     collect(DISTINCT binding) AS bindings
WITH subject, object, gene, evidence,
     reduce(
       sources = [],
       relation IN bindings |
       reduce(
         accumulated = sources,
         source IN coalesce(relation.primary_knowledge_sources, []) |
         CASE
           WHEN source IN accumulated THEN accumulated
           ELSE accumulated + source
         END
       )
     ) AS binding_sources
WHERE (EXISTS {
  MATCH (subject)-[relation:TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(object)
  WHERE 'infores:semmeddb' IN coalesce(relation.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
})
  AND (evidence._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1)
  AND (size(binding_sources) >= 4)
  AND (object._miner_disease_descendant_degree <= 500)
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Five-source TTD-GtoPdb binding consensus with triple translation
results.hypothesis: A directly inhibited causal target supported by both TTD and GtoPdb binding records should be highly predictive when at least three translational evidence channels agree.
results.body: direct inhibited causal target plus TTD and GtoPdb binding, >=5 binding sources, and >=3 translational evidence channels
results.mechanism_rationale: Adds strong target-binding consensus and multiple translational channels to a causal-target path, but the translational evidence is treatment-oriented and causal activity direction is missing.
results.trapi_notes: The causal-target motif is TRAPI-expressible; binding provenance cardinality and the multi-channel evidence count require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
WITH subject, object, gene, evidence,
     collect(DISTINCT binding) AS bindings
WITH subject, object, gene, evidence,
     reduce(
       sources = [],
       relation IN bindings |
       reduce(
         accumulated = sources,
         source IN coalesce(relation.primary_knowledge_sources, []) |
         CASE
           WHEN source IN accumulated THEN accumulated
           ELSE accumulated + source
         END
       )
     ) AS binding_sources
WHERE ('infores:ttd' IN binding_sources)
  AND ('infores:gtopdb' IN binding_sources)
  AND ((
  CASE WHEN EXISTS {

  MATCH (subject)-[trial:IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR]->(object)

  CASE WHEN EXISTS {
  MATCH (subject)-[relation:TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(object)
  WHERE 'infores:ctd' IN coalesce(relation.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN EXISTS {
  MATCH (subject)-[relation:TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(object)
  WHERE 'infores:text-mining-provider-targeted'
        IN coalesce(relation.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN EXISTS {
  MATCH (subject)-[relation:TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(object)
  WHERE 'infores:semmeddb' IN coalesce(relation.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN EXISTS {
  MATCH (subject)-[relation:CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(object)
  WHERE 'infores:text-mining-provider-targeted'

  CASE WHEN EXISTS {
  MATCH (subject)-[relation:CORRELATED_WITH]->(object)
  WHERE 'infores:ctd' IN coalesce(relation.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

  AND (size(binding_sources) >= 5)
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

  WHERE 'infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials'
